name: Productized 72-hour websites
one_liner: Fixed-price, template-based websites delivered in 72 hours to small businesses and founders.
customer: Small business owners and early-stage founders who need a credible site fast
offer: A conversion-focused website built from a template in 72 hours
how_it_makes_money: Fixed price of about $2,500 per site. Demand peaks in December, when buyers want a tax-deductible expense before year end.
evidence: 'we had like seven people buy websites in between Christmas and New Year's' for the year-end tax write-off (ykw6ArIAMOg)
risks: The US tax-timing angle may not carry over to UK/PT tax years (UK tax year ends 5 April)

name: Members-only private court club
one_liner: Rent an unused metal building, put in a court, and sell key-card memberships validated by local Facebook lead ads before opening.
customer: Local recreational players within about 6 miles who want private, bookable court time
offer: 24/7 key-card access, court reservations, lounge, shower and vending
how_it_makes_money: $99/month membership with guaranteed sessions and paid add-on sessions. Membership numbers are capped.
startup_cost: low to validate ($200 in ads); medium to high for the fit-out (building rent, court, septic/bathroom)
time_to_first_revenue: pre-orders within weeks of running ads; full revenue once the space opens
evidence: 'i've spent $200 in ads that's the whole club ... i'm full' (zPL6HfcOLqw)
'99 bucks a month reserve a court' with a 6-mile radius covering about 174k–205k people (zPL6HfcOLqw)
The '$20K/Month' title figure and '100 grand a month' are claims, not shown revenue (zPL6HfcOLqw)
risks: Leads may not convert into paying members
Pickleball demand in the UK/PT is smaller than in the US (padel is the closer local analogue)

name: Bathtub refinishing service
one_liner: Local service that resurfaces worn bathtubs instead of replacing them.
how_it_makes_money: Per-job fees. One operator with 1–2 employees reportedly makes $200k–$500k a year.
evidence: 'he's got one or two employees ... making anywhere between two and $500,000 a year' (zPL6HfcOLqw)
risks: Health and safety rules for chemical coatings

name: Automated niche content theme pages
one_liner: Run niche Instagram theme pages (e.g. vegan recipes) filled through an automated pipeline that collects trending videos and schedules a month of posts in about 45 minutes.
customer: Advertisers or your own app/product, monetised through the page's audience
offer: Niche audience pages used as a distribution channel
how_it_makes_money: Indirect: drives installs or sales for your own product, or sells promotions. No revenue figures are given.
evidence: '45 minutes and it's a month's worth of viral cooking content' (ykw6ArIAMOg)
A similar 'day 1...' format was 'seen working' on another account (ykw6ArIAMOg)
risks: Reposting other creators' videos raises copyright and platform-ban risk

name: Niche AI subscription app via paid ads
one_liner: Small AI consumer app (e.g. an AI cooking assistant) sold by subscription and grown through Facebook ads to a landing page or the App Store.
customer: Consumers with a niche interest (home cooks, sourdough bakers)
how_it_makes_money: About $60/year subscription. The stated target is $100k–$200k/year rather than a venture-scale outcome.
startup_cost: low (template site, AI-written copy, Stripe, ad test budget)
time_to_first_revenue: unknown (the app was still awaiting App Store approval)
evidence: 'do I think I can go make 100 200k off of it sure' is aspiration only, not results (ykw6ArIAMOg)
risks: Not launched, so there is no proof
Paid-ad payback on a $60/yr product is uncertain

name: DTC bulky-goods manufacturing (Filterbuy model)
one_liner: Make a bulky, expensive-to-ship consumable locally and sell it direct to consumers, so importers can't compete.
offer: Locally made air filters sold online
how_it_makes_money: High-volume e-commerce: about $25M/month, roughly 20–25k orders a day.
startup_cost: high (manufacturing); the founder started by dropshipping office supplies
evidence: 'usually makes about 25 million dollars a month' (zbqKCF6gkPE)
'bulky and expensive to ship, which means like importing them isn't really realistic' (zbqKCF6gkPE)
risks: Poor fit for a time-limited solo founder; the thesis is the takeaway, not the scale
